items.title: Jagan regrets YSRCP’s backing of 2023 Election Commissioner appointment law
items.summary: Amid protests against the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls, former Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister and YSR Congress Party chief YS Jagan Mohan Reddy on Sunday, October 18, said he regretted supporting a law introduced by the BJP-led Union government that changed the process for appointing Election Commissioners. Jagan made the remarks while accusing the State Election Commission of bias during nominations for local body elections in Andhra Pradesh, where political violence between the YSRCP and the Telugu Desam Party (TDP) has intensified. Jagan said that the appointments of Election Commissioners should be “neutral.” "Both the State Election Commissioners and the Chief Election Commissioners should not be nominated by the ruling parties. In the past we have supported the Union government’s mechanism to make appointments by the ruling party. But we regret it today. We regret committing that mistake. Because an examiner cannot be appointed by a student," he said.
